admin.funnel.title: Funnel dashboard
admin.funnel.description: Unique-visitor conversion from the site's own event table. Days are cut at UTC+8.
admin.funnel.card.unpaid_hint: Users who reached a payment page in the last 24h and have not paid since.
admin.funnel.footnote.title: Definitions
admin.funnel.footnote.unique: Every step counts unique visitors (hl_did cookie), not impressions; percentages under each step are relative to visitors in the same row. The daily table de-duplicates within each UTC+8 day.
admin.funnel.footnote.visit: Visitors = browsers that opened the generator page (/ or /ai-livestream, event hl_home_view, sent from the browser; bot user agents dropped).
admin.funnel.footnote.first_touch: Source / country = external referrer or utm_source and cf-ipcountry at the visitor's first event, pinned by cookie. Visitors who came before tracking shipped are attributed to their first visit after it.
admin.funnel.footnote.checkout: Sent to payment = the server created a payment session (/api/payment/checkout); provider is the one actually used.
admin.funnel.footnote.paid: Payers / revenue come from the order table (status = paid, by paid_at), so webhook-only payments count. Source/country use the payer's earliest event, build uses their latest checkout; payers with no events show as unknown. Revenue sums order amounts with no currency conversion.
admin.funnel.footnote.provider: Provider table is by order creation time: payment success = orders paid ÷ orders created (abandoned checkouts count as unpaid).
admin.funnel.footnote.build: Build = git commit of the page/server that sent the event.
admin.funnel.footnote.compare: Today vs yesterday compares the same clock time: today 00:00 → now against yesterday 00:00 → this time yesterday (UTC+8).
admin.funnel.footnote.excluded: Excluded: test user {ids} and every visitor id that user has used.
admin.funnel.section.history: Traffic since launch (Cloudflare Web Analytics + orders)
admin.funnel.history.synced: Traffic imported through {day}. Run `npx tsx scripts/sync-traffic.ts` to refresh.
admin.funnel.history.not_synced: No traffic imported yet. Run `npx tsx scripts/sync-traffic.ts`.
admin.funnel.footnote.history: Traffic since launch: browser page views and visits come from Cloudflare Web Analytics (a JS beacon only real browsers send, so crawlers are excluded) imported by scripts/sync-traffic.ts. It is sampled: page views are the steadier number; visits (page loads arriving from outside the site) are a rough estimate at this traffic level, so no conversion rate is computed from them. Free previews = distinct devices (the feature ran Oct 2-9). Sign-ups, started checkout (distinct users who created an order), payers and revenue come from the user and order tables. The CN/HK switch only removes those countries from page views and visits.
admin.funnel.footnote.history_referrer: Referrers come from the browser's Referer header. ChatGPT strips it, so most ChatGPT clicks show as direct here; the user table's utm_source (chatgpt.com) is the reliable ChatGPT signal. /admin pages are excluded from traffic and the top pages list.

rap.guide.title: How airapvideo turns photos into an AI rap video
rap.guide.what.title: What is airapvideo?
rap.guide.what.one: airapvideo, short for AI Rap Video, is an AI rap video generator. It makes short music clips in which real people appear to rap, even though nobody recorded a verse. You add one picture of each person, and airapvideo returns a clip where both of you move, gesture and mouth the lyrics on the beat. The format grew out of the two-person rap trend on TikTok, where creators put friends, couples and family into the same booth for a few bars.
rap.guide.what.two: A talking-photo app only moves the lips. An AI rap music video carries the whole performance: head nods, shoulder bounce, hand moves and the handoff between a lead rapper and a hype partner. That is why the result reads as rapping instead of speaking.
rap.guide.works.title: How the airapvideo generator works
rap.guide.works.one: airapvideo runs in two passes. First, an image model builds a stage shot: both people on one set, framed for a vertical 9:16 screen, with each face, hairstyle and outfit kept from the source photos. Second, a motion model transfers a recorded two-person rap performance onto that stage shot. It maps the rhythm of the verse onto mouth shapes and body movement, and the original audio comes with it, so the lip sync and the beat line up without any editing.
rap.guide.works.two: Because the motion comes from a real performance, the timing feels human. You don't type prompts or set keyframes. The rap video generator handles framing, lip sync and sound in one run, and the finished file is saved in My videos.
rap.guide.make.title: Make a rap video on airapvideo in a few minutes
rap.guide.make.one: Pick two clear photos, choose a knees-up or full-body shot, choose an 8 or 15 second verse and press Create. Most renders finish in about three to five minutes, and you can close the tab while it works. When the clip is ready, download the MP4 without a watermark and post it to TikTok, Instagram Reels or YouTube Shorts.
rap.guide.why.title: Why use airapvideo instead of editing by hand
rap.guide.why.one: Making a rap music video the usual way means filming two people, recording audio and syncing lips in an editor frame by frame. airapvideo skips the shoot. It also works when the two people live in different cities, since each photo can be taken anywhere. You keep control where it matters: who leads, how the shot is framed, and a short style note for outfits or accessories.
rap.guide.best.title: Getting the best AI rap video from a photo
rap.guide.best.one: Results depend on the source photos. Sharp, front-facing portraits with even light give the model a strong reference, and similar framing in both photos helps the two people look like they share one stage. Keep the style note to a single detail. If a face drifts, try a clearer photo before adding more direction. And only use photos of people who agreed to be in the video.

rap.faq.title: airapvideo FAQ
rap.faq.one.question: What is airapvideo?
rap.faq.one.answer: airapvideo is an AI rap video generator that turns photos of two people into a short rap music video. Both people appear on one stage and rap together, with moves, lip sync and audio included.
rap.faq.two.question: How do I make an AI rap video on airapvideo?
rap.faq.two.answer: Sign in, upload one photo for each rapper, pick a shot and a length, then press Create. The stage shot appears in under a minute and the finished video in about 3-5 minutes. Download it as an MP4 with no watermark.
rap.faq.three.question: Is airapvideo a free AI rap video generator?
rap.faq.three.answer: Rendering a video uses credits, and the exact cost for 8 and 15 seconds is shown on the button and in pricing. You buy a one-time credit pack, with no subscription.
rap.faq.four.question: Do I need an app or editing skills?
rap.faq.four.answer: No. It runs in your browser and there is nothing to film or edit. You don't need CapCut or any other tool.
rap.faq.five.question: Can I use my own song or lyrics?
rap.faq.five.answer: Not yet. This version transfers a built-in two-person rap performance and its audio. Your own track and AI-written verses are on the roadmap.
rap.faq.six.question: Do I pay for failed renders? Do credits expire?
rap.faq.six.answer: No to both. If a render fails, the credits return to your balance automatically, and purchased credits don't expire while your account is active.
rap.faq.seven.question: Can I make a rap video with a friend or family member?
rap.faq.seven.answer: Yes, as long as they agreed to it. Children may only appear if you are their parent or legal guardian. Please label the result as AI-generated when you share it.
rap.faq.eight.question: What does airapvideo do with my photos?
rap.faq.eight.answer: Photos are resized in your browser and only uploaded when you press Create. They are sent to our AI provider (fal.ai) to make the stage shot and video, and nothing is made public.
rap.faq.nine.question: Can I post the MP4 on TikTok and Reels?
rap.faq.nine.answer: Yes. Download it without a watermark and post it on TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts or anywhere else. Follow each platform's rules for AI content and label the video as AI-generated.
